title: Calendar-month seasonality
summary: Average available valid years, requiring at least two; rank highest first without a positive-mean filter. Require a finite current close, positive current volume and uninterrupted finite prices within each sampled month.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: Before the holding month, collect that same calendar month’s close-to-close returns from the preceding five calendar years, using complete past months only. Average available valid years, requiring at least two; rank highest first without a positive-mean filter. Require a finite current close, positive current volume and uninterrupted finite prices within each sampled month. Select up to 10 stocks and review monthly. Before January 2025, use available January returns from 2020–2024, never January 2025.
rules.exit: Sell when removed at a review. No stop-loss or take-profit. Estimate terminal liquidation at final close.
rules.sizing: Up to 10 stocks. Signal equity / 10 per new position; fractional shares; retained positions are not resized.
rules.execution: Rank on a completed session. Sell removals at the next tradable open; buy additions at signal + 3 sessions.

limitations: Short-history, long-only stock seasonality adaptation. The lookback is five calendar years, not five sessions; at least two complete same-month returns are required.
The cache begins in 2015. January 2018 has at most two usable prior January returns; early reviews use fewer than five observations and the seasonal estimate is especially noisy.
Current Nifty 500-derived universe, not historical constituents: survivorship and selection bias.
2018–2025 influenced parameter selection. The 2026 comparison has been inspected repeatedly; it is not an untouched holdout.
Fractional adjusted shares and normalized starting equity 100; no account-size, market-impact or whole-share constraint.
Current proportional delivery fees applied to all history; fixed DP fees, dividends, delisting proceeds and historical fee changes omitted.
Provider adjustments, retrospective exclusions and terminal-close estimates limit executable interpretation.
